missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Снег' stays in the nominative case as the subject of 'идёт'. 'Белый' is the agreeing masculine adjective, and 'на улице' gives the location.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Снег' is inanimate masculine, so its accusative matches the nominative as the object of 'любят'. 'Первый' agrees in the masculine accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive of quantity. 'Снега' is in the genitive case after 'много', expressing an amount. 'Зимой' is an instrumental time adverb, and 'в горах' gives the place.
Strategic focus: Dative object. 'Снегу' is in the dative case required by 'радуются'. 'Первому' agrees in the masculine dative, describing the first snow of the season.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of means. 'Снегом' is in the instrumental case expressing what covers the road. 'Белым' agrees in the masculine instrumental, and 'покрыта' is the short passive.

missions.phrase: Дети играют в снегу весь день.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Locative prepositional. 'В снегу' uses the special locative form 'снегу' after 'в' to express playing in the snow. 'Весь день' adds the accusative duration.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Снег' is nominative as the subject of 'растаял'. 'Уже' marks completion, and 'на дорогах' gives the prepositional plural location.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Снега' is the nominative plural of 'снег', here meaning snowfalls, as the subject of 'идут'. 'Зимой' and 'часто' add time and frequency.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'По снегу' uses the dative form 'снегу' after 'по' to express walking over the surface. 'Долго' adds duration to 'гуляли'.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Без снега' uses the genitive form 'снега' after 'без' to express absence. 'Зима' is the nominative subject of 'кажется'.
